run_comparison.interpretation: Consistent with position-controlled palm contact, not missing commanded force, destabilising the late rise; the handoff is not transient-free and the sampled margin is thin.

findings.title: fallback path unexercised
findings.detail: No guard fired in the passing run. After a guard the palms restart from up to 0.05 m clearance (0.02-0.05 m/s depth recovery), force returns only after gated contact at 30-90 N/s and is tip-limited near 49 N per hand; v26/v30 show about 48 N per hand did not arrest the backward loss. The handoff is effectively a commit point.

findings.title: soft re-arm after a guard
findings.detail: The phase can re-enter after 0.15 s of renewed eligibility with a fresh 8 s timer; no cooldown or attempt count; bounded only by the 56 s window.

findings.title: dwell is zero-request, not contact-free
findings.detail: Hand targets freeze at action end. Rise continues 0.913 to 1.0 (torso +0.037 m, pelvis +0.054 m in x). Left palm contact flag and gate true at 60 s and 80 s (gap 0.034 m) with zero commanded and applied force. Passive palm contact load is not in the supplied samples. CoM 0.064 m ahead of the ankle is inside the foot (-0.08 to +0.22 m).

findings.title: dwell actuator state
findings.detail: Internal balance couple at its 30 N m cap in pitch; saturation ticks 117 (45.45 s), 816 (60 s), 1869 (80 s), about 80 % and 88 % of 60 Hz control ticks; CoM 0.032 m ahead of plan, trim -2.5 deg, ankle error 2.4-2.7 deg. Positions repeat to about 1e-6 m between 60 s and 80 s while sampled velocities stay near 0.035 m/s: consistent with tick-synchronous chatter of about 0.3 mm, not drift. No perturbation margin demonstrated.

findings.title: robot_human_contact true while both palm flags are false (41.0-45.45 s)
findings.detail: Metric is either latched or a non-palm link touches the person; the record should state which.

findings.title: interface force abstraction
findings.detail: Bilateral pull toward the robot and up, gated by palm proximity; not a unilateral friction-limited contact. Gate can hold force for 0.12 s plus one control tick after contact ends.

findings.title: handoff transient and thin sampled margin
findings.detail: CoM velocity +0.03 to -0.065 m/s within 0.45 s of entry; capture point about -0.029 m at 40.0 s against a heel edge at -0.08 m; minimum between samples unknown.

findings.title: fragility and stale text
findings.detail: Direct index of support_center_m in the wrapper; lift/boost/instability bookkeeping not updated during the phase; entry tilt 47.0 against a bound of 50 deg; human.py docstring (30-90 % unlean), policy header (0..18 deg elevation) and README (50.45 s diagnostic) are stale.

findings.title: display retarget limits
findings.detail: Vertical only, mean of both ankles; per-foot and horizontal mismatch remain. Whole skin including torso and head moves by the same offset (about 7.5 cm standing, reported), so visible palm-chest contact location and head height are not metric. Baseline latched at first update.

proposals.text: From the existing full trace report minimum xc, minimum capture point, maximum speed and pelvis-drop margin over 39.55-44.45 s, and palm-torso contact impulse over 45.43-80 s.
Offline fault injection of each guard (drop, backward CoM, overspeed, timeout, window end) and an ablation of the handoff with the old 0.30/0.90 unlean.
Log ankle_alignment_offset_m per frame with the capture timestamps.
Correct the stale text in F8 and state F1-F4 in the published README.
Only if a contact-free dwell is ever claimed: a separately recorded revision could keep the bounded release-clearance following after the action ends. Not proposed for this run.
